correctness.rationale: Classical blowup identifies every smooth complex cubic surface with the same 27-line incidence. The sum of any tritangent triple is anticanonical and orthogonal to all E6 roots; pairings in {-1,0,1} therefore force exactly 0 or 2 lines in a double-six. Two independent complete double-six enumerations (72 sixers and 36 opposite-root supports) agree. A deterministic exact integer checker constructs all 36x45 entries, uses only unimodular Euclidean operations, validates the final SNF and divisibility, and cross-checks rank via two Gram annihilating polynomials. Separate SymPy SNF gives identical factors. This is a complete finite certificate for the universal geometric model, not a sample-based extrapolation.

value.rationale: Two canonical and separately well-studied geometric presentations of the E6 cubic-surface configuration interact through a natural half-overlap integer pairing. The complete cokernels reveal 3-primary obstructions (order 3^7), a distinct order-two difference between overlap and nonoverlap pairings, and free rank 15, data not visible in rational incidence rank or in the separate 2-primary double-six and saturated tritangent line matrices. This is a structurally motivated integral comparison, not an arbitrarily chosen submatrix.
